Guide To Debloating Windows:

The process of debloating Windows 10/11 is best done on a fresh installation of Windows. I hope you’re using W10, and not W11. Use 0Patch to stay up to date with security updates even after Microsoft kills off W10 on October 14th, 2025.

The Easier Way

To start debloating Windows 10 or 11, I usually start with WinUtil by ChrisTitusTech. Documentation.
